partners.name: Veterans Business Outreach Centers
partners.note: Training and counseling for veteran-owned businesses.

partners.name: Certified Development Companies (504 lenders)
partners.note: Official SBA list of CDC 504 lenders.

partners.name: SBA Microlenders
partners.note: Official SBA list of SBA-approved microloan intermediaries.

lenders.name: SBA Lender Match
lenders.products: SBA 7(a), 504, microloans — official SBA matching service
lenders.details: Free, no-obligation matching with SBA-approved lenders.

lenders.name: Lendio
lenders.products: SBA 7(a), term loans, lines of credit, equipment, revenue-based financing, invoice factoring, commercial mortgages, startup loans
lenders.details: Free to apply. States applying does not affect your personal credit score. Assigns a dedicated funding expert. Paid by lenders (may affect placement).

lenders.name: Fundera by NerdWallet
lenders.products: SBA, term loans, lines of credit, equipment, invoice financing, merchant cash advances, commercial real estate
lenders.details: Free to compare. Funding Advisor available. Earns a percentage from the provider once funded.

lenders.name: Nav
lenders.products: Business credit monitoring plus funding matches
lenders.details: Free plan available. Nav Prime plans $39.99–$74.99/month. Uses soft pulls for credit monitoring.

lenders.name: LendingTree
lenders.details: Arranges multiple conditional offers from non-affiliated lenders. Paid by providers.

lenders.name: Rapid Finance
lenders.details: Lender-matching marketplace packaging applications for partner review.

lenders.name: National Funding
lenders.products: Term loans, lines of credit, SBA loans
lenders.details: Marketplace and lender-ready application packaging across financing routes.

lenders.name: SmartBiz
lenders.products: SBA and non-SBA small business loans
lenders.details: SBA-focused marketplace packaging SBA and non-SBA submissions.

lenders.name: BlueVine
lenders.products: Invoice financing, business lines of credit
lenders.details: Direct lender built around business receivables.

lenders.name: Fundbox
lenders.products: Invoice financing, lines of credit, term loans
lenders.details: Direct lender; also offers embedded financing for platforms.

lenders.name: OnDeck
lenders.details: Direct online lender for small businesses.

lenders.name: Fora Financial
lenders.details: Up to $1.5M. Published factor rates 1.05–1.5. Typical minimums: 6+ months in business, $240K+ annual revenue, 570+ credit score.

lenders.name: Credibly
lenders.details: Direct lender focused on receivables-driven funding.

lenders.name: Biz2Credit
lenders.details: Term loans made by Itria Ventures LLC or Cross River Bank. Published minimums: FICO 650 and $100,000 revenue.

lenders.name: StreetShares
lenders.products: Small business loans, lines of credit

lenders.name: Kabbage
lenders.details: American Express company. Small business credit and lines of credit.
